purpose: Render development docs for a non-game internal web platform without template drift.
packaging: Docker Compose for infrastructure, local app processes for development
constraints: Keep development docs product-neutral and aligned to finalized state.

product.problemStatement: Operations teams need one internal system for location and contact data instead of inconsistent spreadsheets.
product.targetUsers: Internal editors and read-only operational users
product.whyNow: The initial spreadsheet seed is messy and the development handoff must preserve the product model cleanly.
product.expectedValue: Development docs stay aligned to the finalized web-platform decisions without inheriting game-template language.
product.solutionSummary: Build an editor-first internal web platform with separate read and editor surfaces backed by shared PostgreSQL.
product.mvpScope: Monorepo foundation, auth, editor API, and location CRUD before import review and read surfaces.
product.outOfScope: General-purpose public commerce features or self-service account creation.
product.assumptions: Finalized state is the source of truth for generated development docs.
product.nonGoals: Reintroducing template-specific vertical-slice wording that does not match the product.

governance.keyDecisions: Use one monorepo, server-managed cookie sessions, editor API first, and a product-neutral render path.
governance.topRisks: Development docs may drift away from finalized state or reintroduce template-specific language.
governance.mitigationPlans: Validate generated docs against banned terms and preserve curated artifact references across finalize.
governance.contingencies: Regenerate from finalized state and review semantic drift before switching to development mode.
governance.remainingAcceptedRisks: Some wording may still evolve as the generic template improves.
